quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards on the physical toll of dunking
quotes.excerpt: If you try dunking too hard, it hurts.

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Edwards
text_blocks.text: No. I mean, it hurts if you try dunking too hard. Usually, I just get up there and just throw it in, because it will hurt if you try like that.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards on his favorite NBA arenas to play in
quotes.excerpt: Madison Square, TD garden, New York, Boston. Philly, and Atlanta at home.

text_blocks.speaker: Andrea Kimi Antonelli
text_blocks.text: And which is your favorite place to play?

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Edwards
text_blocks.text: Well, of course home or Madison Square. Madison Square, TD garden, New York, Boston. Philly, and Atlanta at home.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards on his approach to trash talking
quotes.excerpt: A lot of players don't talk trash, but I do. If I'm scoring a lot of points, I'm talking crazy!

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Edwards
text_blocks.text: A lot of players don't talk trash, but I do. If I'm scoring a lot of points, I'm talking crazy! They can't guard me out here, man! Find somebody who can guard me! He ain't it. I be talking a lot of trash. I talk trash for my teammates, too. If my teammate is having a good game, I'll talk trash for him. I'll be like, 'Don't say nothing, I got you!'
